## FAQ

### What courier services does XpressBees offer?

XpressBees provides nationwide end-to-end logistics solutions across 19,000+ pin codes in India. Key services include:
Express Parcel Delivery (https://www.xpressbees.com/services/b2c-logistics-services/express-parcel-delivery): Express Shipping, Same-day and next-day delivery options for high-priority shipments.
eCommerce & D2C Logistics (https://www.xpressbees.com/services/b2c-logistics-services/d2c-logistics): First-mile collection, automated order fulfillment, and reverse logistics (returns).
Hyperlocal & Quick Commerce: Fast local pickups and rapid last mile delivery.
B2B & Cargo Shipping: Part-Truckload (PTL) and Full-Truckload (FTL) bulk movement.
3PL Warehousing: Scalable storage and inventory management across 4,500+ fulfillment centers.
XpressBees serves marketplace sellers, D2C brands, enterprise clients, and individual shippers with end-to-end tracking and pickup solutions.

### What is eCommerce logistics, and how does XpressBees support online sellers?

eCommerce logistics is the complete supply chain process of managing inventory, storing products, processing orders, and delivering goods from an online business to the end customer. It includes first-mile pickup, warehousing, order fulfillment, last mile shipping, and reverse logistics.
XpressBees supports eCommerce (https://www.xpressbees.com/solutions/e-commerce) logistics through:
Nationwide Coverage: Fast shipping across 19,000+ pin codes in India, including same-day delivery across 50+ major cities and next-day delivery to 8,500+ pin codes.
3PL Warehousing & Fulfillment: Automated picking, packing, and tech-driven inventory tracking across 4,500+ fulfillment centers to speed up order dispatch.
Express & Last Mile Shipping: Reliable B2C express parcel delivery backed by a team of 30,000+ last mile delivery partners.
Hassle-Free Reverse Logistics: End-to-end management of customer returns across 18,000+ pin codes.
Quick Commerce Integration: Rapid order fulfillment solutions tailored for hyper-local delivery demands.
Read our complete guide to eCommerce Logistics (https://www.xpressbees.com/services/b2c-logistics-services/e-commerce-logistics) to learn how to streamline your supply chain.

### Does XpressBees provide B2B transport services?

Yes, XpressBees provides comprehensive B2B transport and freight logistics (https://www.xpressbees.com/services/b2b-logistics-services) across India.
Our nationwide B2B network offers flexible freight solutions designed for manufacturers, distributors, and retailers:
Part-Truckload (PTL): Cost-effective shared cargo movement for smaller business shipments.
Full-Truckload (FTL): Dedicated point-to-point truck transport for high-volume cargo.
Hub-to-Hub Transit: Scheduled surface freight connecting 260+ processing hubs across primary industrial routes.
Real-Time Visibility: GPS tracking and milestone updates for end-to-end cargo movement.

### What is D2C logistics, and how does XpressBees support direct-to-consumer brands?

D2C (Direct-to-Consumer) logistics (https://www.xpressbees.com/services/b2c-logistics-services/d2c-logistics) is the complete supply chain process that enables brand owners to store, package, and deliver products directly to end customers without third-party retail intermediaries.
XpressBees supports D2C brands with:
Nationwide Coverage: Express shipping to 19,000+ pin codes with flexible cash-on-delivery (COD) management.
Fast Delivery Options: Same-day and next-day delivery capabilities across major metro markets.
3PL Order Fulfilments: Distributed warehousing in 4,500+ centres to store inventory closer to target buyers.
Smooth Returns: Automated reverse pickup management across 18,000+ pin codes to boost customer trust.

### How does XpressBees handle eCommerce delivery for online sellers?

XpressBees handles eCommerce delivery (https://www.xpressbees.com/solutions/e-commerce) through an end-to-end automated logistics network tailored for sellers of all sizes.
Key features for online sellers include:
First-Mile Doorstep Pickup: Automated scheduling for direct inventory collection from seller warehouses or hubs.
Wide Reach: Delivery coverage extending across 19,000+ pin codes in India.
Flexible Payment Options: Prepaid and Cash on Delivery (COD) processing with rapid remittance cycles.
Real-Time Parcel Tracking: Live status tracking and automated customer notifications via SMS and WhatsApp.

### What is hyperlocal delivery, and does XpressBees offer it?

Hyperlocal delivery (https://www.xpressbees.com/services/b2b-logistics-services/hyperlocal-b2b-retail-logistics) is a short-distance shipping service that delivers goods within a specific city or local region—typically within hours or on the same day.
Yes, XpressBees offers hyperlocal delivery services engineered for quick commerce platforms, retail stores, and local eCommerce merchants. Our hyperlocal solutions support rapid last mile pickups, intra-city B2B order replenishment, and fast local doorstep delivery.

### What is Last mile delivery, and how does XpressBees manage it?

Last mile delivery is the final leg of the supply chain process, where a parcel moves from a local distribution hub directly to the customer's doorstep.
XpressBees manages Last mile delivery using a dedicated network of 30,000+ delivery partners (https://www.xpressbees.com/partner/delivery-partner) backed by route-optimization software. This combination ensures precise address verification, higher first-attempt delivery rates, and reliable on-time delivery.
Read our full guide to Last Mile Delivery (https://www.xpressbees.com/services/b2c-logistics-services/last-mile-delivery) to learn more.

### Does XpressBees offer reverse logistics services?

Yes, XpressBees offers complete reverse logistics (https://www.xpressbees.com/services/b2c-logistics-services/reverse-logistics) and Return-to-Origin (RTO) management for both B2C and B2B businesses.
Our reverse logistics solutions include:
Doorstep Quality Checks (QC): Item verification at the time of pickup to prevent incorrect return returns.
Wide Doorstep Pickup Reach: Reverse pickup coverage across 18,000+ pin codes.
Rapid Turnaround Times: Fast return transit back to fulfillment hubs to restore sellable inventory quickly.
B2B Cargo Return Handling: Commercial freight return movement for defective or overstock bulk goods.

### What is RTO, and how does XpressBees minimize return rates?

RTO (Return to Origin) (https://www.xpressbees.com/services/b2c-logistics-services/reverse-logistics) occurs when an eCommerce order cannot be delivered to the buyer (due to incorrect address, customer refusal, or failed delivery attempts) and must be returned to the seller.
XpressBees minimizes RTO losses through:
Address Intelligence: Automated address validation before dispatch to identify incomplete or fake addresses.
NDR (Non-Delivery Report) Workflows: Real-time customer re-engagement via automated messaging to fix address issues before initiating a return.
Multi-Attempt Deliveries: Re-attempting delivery based on buyer-selected time slots.

### Can XpressBees handle bulk cargo shipments?

Yes, XpressBees handles bulk cargo shipments through its specialized B2B surface logistics network (https://www.xpressbees.com/services/b2b-logistics-services).
Designed for manufacturers, wholesalers, and enterprise retailers, our bulk cargo capabilities include:
Part-Truckload (https://www.xpressbees.com/services/b2b-logistics-services/part-truck-load) (PTL): Cost-effective transport for palletized or unitized commercial goods.
Full-Truckload (https://www.xpressbees.com/services/b2b-logistics-services/full-truck-load) (FTL): Dedicated multi-ton trucks for direct factory-to-warehouse or warehouse-to-retailer transit.
Heavy & Oversized Parcel Handling (https://www.xpressbees.com/services/b2b-logistics-services/multi-modal-transport): Specialized infrastructure at 260+ transport hubs to safely manage heavy freight.

### What is surface transport, and how does XpressBees use it?

Surface transport refers to moving commercial goods and cargo by road or rail networks across regional and national routes.
XpressBees utilizes surface transport for both B2B & B2C logistics (https://www.xpressbees.com/services/b2c-logistics-services) through:
Full-Truckload (FTL): Dedicated point-to-point trucks for large volume or direct-factory consignments.
Part-Truckload (PTL): Cost-effective, consolidated shipment movement for mid-sized cargo.
Line-Haul Transit (https://www.xpressbees.com/services/b2b-logistics-services/line-haul-hub-to-hub-movement): High-frequency hub-to-hub cargo transport connecting 260+ processing hubs across India.

### Does XpressBees offer express shipping?

Yes, XpressBees offers express shipping (https://www.xpressbees.com/services/b2c-logistics-services/express-parcel-delivery) solutions for urgent domestic deliveries.
Key features of our express network include:
Domestic Express Parcel: Priority air and surface transit offering same-day and next-day delivery options across major Indian metros.
Priority Routing: Dedicated hub processing and automated sorting to ensure high speed and minimal transit delays.

### What eCommerce fulfillment services does XpressBees provide?

XpressBees provides end-to-end eCommerce fulfillment (https://www.xpressbees.com/services/b2c-logistics-services/micro-fulfillment-warehousing) to help online sellers store, manage, and dispatch inventory efficiently.
Our fulfillment center capabilities include:
Smart Warehousing: Strategic inventory storage across 4,500+ fulfillment centers in India.
Automated Order Processing: Tech-enabled picking, packing, and labelling integrated with leading sales channels.
Distributed Inventory: Storing goods closer to local demand zones to enable faster, cheaper shipping.

### Does XpressBees offer eCommerce warehousing solutions?

Yes, XpressBees offers scalable 3PL (Third-Party Logistics) (https://www.xpressbees.com/services/third-party-logistics) warehousing and storage solutions for eCommerce and D2C brands.
Our warehousing services include:
Multi-Tenant Warehousing: Flexible, pay-as-you-use shared storage without heavy capital investment.
Inventory Management & Control: Real-time visibility into stock levels, SKU tracking, and batch control via automated Warehouse Management Systems (WMS).
Direct Fulfillment Integration: Seamless handoff from storage racks to lastmile courier dispatch.

### What parcel delivery options does XpressBees offer?

XpressBees offers three main parcel delivery modes to suit different speed and budget requirements:
Standard Parcel Delivery: Economical doorstep delivery covering 19,000+ pin codes nationwide.
Express Parcel Delivery (https://www.xpressbees.com/services/b2c-logistics-services/express-parcel-delivery): Time-critical shipping for priority orders with same-day or next-day fulfillment.
Hyperlocal Delivery: Rapid intra-city shipping engineered for quick-commerce and local retail orders.
All delivery options support digital payments, Cash-on-Delivery (COD) (https://www.xpressbees.com/services/b2c-logistics-services/cod-digital-payment-options), and live tracking updates.

### Does XpressBees support retail logistics?

Yes, XpressBees provides omni-channel retail logistics designed to streamline inventory flow for retail businesses.
Our retail logistics capabilities include:
B2B Retail Logistics (https://www.xpressbees.com/solutions/b2b): Part-Truckload (PTL) and Full-Truckload (FTL) deliveries from central warehouses to retail store networks.
Hyperlocal Store to Door (https://www.xpressbees.com/services/b2b-logistics-services/hyperlocal-b2b-retail-logistics): Delivering products directly from local retail outlets to nearby online buyers.
Cross-Docking & Distribution: Sorting and redirecting goods rapidly to avoid long storage times.

### What is door to door delivery, and does XpressBees provide it?

Door to door delivery is a shipping service where a parcel is collected directly from the sender's location and delivered straight to the recipient's doorstep.
Yes, XpressBees provides door to door delivery across domestic Indian routes (covering 19,000+ pin codes) and through our international courier network (covering 190+ countries). It includes first-mile pickup, transit tracking, customs clearance (for exports), and final delivery.

### What is D2C shipping, and why is it important for brands?

D2C (Direct-to-Consumer) (https://www.xpressbees.com/services/b2c-logistics-services/d2c-logistics) shipping is the fulfillment process that enables brand owners to deliver products directly to buyers without relying on third-party online marketplaces or physical retail stores.
Why it matters: Direct shipping gives brands complete control over the customer experience, unboxing quality, and delivery speed. XpressBees supports D2C growth with automated order tracking, flexible Cash-on-Delivery (COD) options, and nationwide return management across 18,000+ pin codes.

### How does XpressBees ensure reliable eCommerce courier services?

XpressBees ensures high reliability through an automated, data-driven eCommerce courier network.
Key features supporting seamless execution include:
Automated Sorting & Tracking: Real-time visibility across 260+ processing hubs with automated package routing.
Proactive Non-Delivery Report (NDR) Handling: Automated SMS/WhatsApp workflows to verify addresses and prevent unnecessary return attempts.
Flexible Payment Options: Fast, dependable Cash-on-Delivery (COD) reconciliation alongside digital prepaid payment channels.
High SLA Compliance: Same-day delivery capabilities in 50+ cities and next-day delivery across 8,500+ pin codes.

### What logistics solutions does XpressBees offer for SME companies?

XpressBees provides scalable logistics solutions designed to help emerging SMEs, MSMEs, and high-growth brands expand without heavy infrastructure costs.
Solutions for growing businesses include:
3PL Warehousing: Flexible storage across 4,500+ fulfillment locations to decentralize inventory based on regional demand.
Multi-Channel Order Fulfillment: Seamless integration with major eCommerce platforms, marketplaces, and ERP systems.
Scalable Freight Shipping: Cost-effective Part-Truckload (PTL) options to manage growing inventory volumes without booking full trucks.
Automated API Integrations: Easy setup for bulk order booking, tracking updates, and shipping label generation.

### Does XpressBees provide express delivery for urgent shipments?

Yes, XpressBees offers high-priority express delivery (https://www.xpressbees.com/services/b2c-logistics-services/express-parcel-delivery) solutions for time-sensitive shipments.
Our express delivery channels include:
Intra-City Express: Rapid local delivery for same-day urgent orders.
Inter-City Surface & Air Express: Priority route allocation guaranteeing next-day delivery across 8,500+ pin codes.

### How does XpressBees support quick commerce and hyperlocal businesses?

XpressBees powers quick commerce (https://www.xpressbees.com/services/b2c-logistics-services/quick-commerce-delivery) through dedicated hyperlocal courier networks and strategically located micro-fulfillment hubs.
Our quick-commerce capabilities feature:
Micro-Fulfillment Warehousing (https://www.xpressbees.com/services/b2c-logistics-services/micro-fulfillment-warehousing): Small, urban storage nodes placed close to high-density buying zones for fast order picking.
Dedicated Local Fleet: A network of 30,000+ last mile delivery partners for intra-city transit.
Smart Route Optimization: Dynamic dispatch algorithms that calculate optimal routes to minimize transit times and driver delays.

### Why choose XpressBees as your logistics provider?

XpressBees is a leading single-source logistics provider in India, managing 2M+ shipments daily with an integrated B2C (https://www.xpressbees.com/services/b2c-logistics-services), B2B (https://www.xpressbees.com/services/b2b-logistics-services), and 3PL (https://www.xpressbees.com/services/third-party-logistics) shipping infrastructure.
Core Advantages:
Massive Pan-India Reach: Direct service coverage across 19,000+ pin codes.
Full-Stack Capabilities: Integrated services covering express parcels, 3PL warehousing, B2B freight (PTL/FTL), hyperlocal shipping, and cross-border transport.
High Speed at Scale: Same-day delivery in 50+ cities and next-day reach across 8,500+ pin codes.
Tech-First Operations: Real-time tracking, automated address verification, and rapid COD remittance cycles.
